stem: Arjun is 1.6 m tall. He wants a plane mirror on his bedroom wall, hung at the right height, in which he can see himself from head to toe. What is the shortest mirror that will work?

options.C: Less than 0.8 m, if he stands far enough back

r1.text: If he stands farther away, more of him fits in, so a smaller mirror is enough.

r2.text: Light from his feet bounces off the mirror halfway down to his eyes, so he only needs half his height, wherever he stands.

r3.text: The image is on the glass, so the glass has to be as tall as he is.

verify_flags: Assumes a vertical plane mirror with its top edge midway between Arjun's eyes and the top of his head.

stem: At a salon in Pune, Meera sees only her face down to her shoulders in a small mirror fixed on the wall. She takes two steps back. What part of herself does she see now?

options.A: More of herself, down to her waist
options.B: Less of herself, only her face
options.C: Still only her face down to her shoulders
options.D: Her whole body, if she goes back far enough

r1.text: Farther from the mirror means a wider view, so more of her fits in.

r2.text: Her image stays on the glass while she backs away, so the glass covers more of her.

r3.text: Her image moves back as much as she does, so the mirror still covers the same part of her.

verify_flags: Assumes the mirror stays fixed and Meera's eye height does not change as she steps back.

stem: Kabir, 1.7 m tall, is buying a mirror for his hostel room in Vellore. He will stand about 3 m from it. What is the shortest mirror, hung at the right height, that shows him head to toe?

options.B: Less than 0.85 m, because standing 3 m back means he needs less mirror
options.C: 0.85 m only if he stands close; at 3 m he needs a longer one

r1.text: He needs half his height, and the distance doesn't matter because his image moves back with him.

r2.text: His image sits on the mirror, so the mirror must be his full height.

r3.text: Standing far back lets more of him fit, so a shorter mirror will do.

verify_flags: Assumes a vertical plane mirror with its top edge midway between Kabir's eyes and the top of his head.

stem: Ananya stands 3 m in front of the big wall mirror in her dance class. Which statement is correct?

options.A: Her image is 3 m behind the mirror, so it is 6 m from her
options.B: Her image is on the mirror surface, so it is 3 m from her
options.C: If she moves back to 5 m, she will see more of her body in the same mirror
options.D: Her image is 3 m behind the mirror, so it is 3 m from her

r1.text: What I see is right on the glass, so the image is just 3 m away.

r2.text: The image is as far behind the mirror as she is in front, so 3 m + 3 m = 6 m.

r3.text: Moving back lets the mirror catch more of her body.
